about: The man has urinary symptoms from an enlarged prostate and the same line records "Clinician's assessment of prostate surgery: unnecessary". Tamsulosin is supplied, and the Finapen brand alone does not show a 5-alpha reductase inhibitor for prostate symptoms.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about "Lower urinary tract symptoms due to benign prostate enlargement". Tamsulosin (Flomaxtra) is supplied every month and no Group A medicine is supplied.

The record holds a line for benign prostatic hyperplasia with urinary symptoms and "Clinician's assessment of prostate surgery: unnecessary". Dutasteride (Avodart) is supplied every month to the end of the history, so the 5-alpha reductase inhibitor is there.
